statement: A sufficient sample size for rejection probability at least 1-v is m >= C(alpha,v)/(NAMMD(P,Q;k)-epsilon)^2.
assumptions: bounded kernel assumptions inherited from the test
acceptance: Across a positive gap sweep, m*gap^2 is invariant and the log-log slope is -2; an inverse-linear mutation must fail.
important_scope: This is a sufficient upper bound and main scaling term, not an asserted empirical equality for minimum sample size.
